boxes.t: One account per company, one plan per user

siv.text: Valanto grows out of the daily work of valuation. That keeps the platform close to what you really need in practice – rather than what off-the-shelf software offers.

points.d: We handle your data in accordance with Swiss data protection law – hosted in Switzerland with Infomaniak (Geneva).
Your feedback goes straight into development. We're a small team, not a ticketing system.

items.q: Which valuation methods does Valanto offer?
items.a: Real value with age depreciation by building component, income value and residual value. You choose the methods for each valuation and weight them in percent. A DCF method has been prepared and is under professional review. There is no sales comparison method.

items.q: Where does the market value come from?
items.a: From your inputs: the weighted average of the chosen methods, less deferred maintenance and right of residence, and you can override it manually at any time. No external pricing models, no hedonic estimates, no AI in the value. Transparently calculated, not estimated.
The appraisal report as PDF (archived on completion), the sales dossier as PDF, the exposé as a public page with a dossier version, contacts and invoices as CSV. There is no Word export.

Contacts as CSV, using a template. Enquiries from your website arrive directly in Valanto via an interface. On request, we transfer legacy data from a previous system for you. An import from the Federal Register of Buildings and Dwellings (GWR) is planned.

items.q: Does my logo appear in the appraisal report?
items.a: Yes. Your logo and accent colour shape the appraisal report, dossier, exposé, seller portal, invoices, project page and website widget. Plus contact photo, contact person, title below the signature and up to three association logos in the dossier.

items.q: What happens to my data if I cancel?
items.a: The subscription can be cancelled monthly. On request, you receive your data within 30 days in a common format; after that it is deleted unless a retention obligation applies. You can also delete your account yourself. Hosting is in Switzerland with Infomaniak in Geneva, with daily encrypted backups.
One office location equals one account. The cap per plan applies to all users of that account. Multiple locations and branch networks: flat-rate solution on request.

items.q: What language does Valanto run in?
items.a: German. The interface can also be used in English; appraisal reports, dossiers and legal texts are in German.

cta.h2: Try it out at your own pace.
cta.text: Your free account starts with sample data to look around and has room for one property, one valuation with dossier and one new-build project of your own – no time limit. No credit card, no notice period.
